title: 第二十一章 青光狼圈第二十二章 特殊本领
content_zh:
姜云在小女孩的带领下，向着百兽峰走去。
大概是因为终于有人肯帮自己了，让小女孩的心情变得大好，一路之上蹦蹦跳跳，拉着姜云叽叽喳喳不停说着话从小女孩的口中，姜云自然也对她的情况有所了解。
这个女孩名叫陆笑瑜，今年刚满十二岁，比姜月柔要大上两岁，如今已经是通脉二重之境。
说起来，陆笑瑜的身世和姜月柔也是颇为相似，父母双亡，和爷爷相依为命，但是当姜云问起她爷爷的时候，陆笑瑜却是支支吾吾，不愿多说，只说爷爷将她送来问道宗就离开了，显然是有着什么难言之隐。
姜云自然也就没有往下追问，不过相似的身世，却是让姜云心中对陆笑瑜也多了几分关心。
只可惜姜云自己在这问道宗内也同为杂役，不能给予她什么实质性的帮助，只能将自己的住处告诉了她，让她如果再遇到什么困难的话，可以去找自己，自己会尽力相助。
听到姜云的许诺，陆笑瑜高兴的眼睛都笑成了一条缝，连连点头答应。
一个多时辰之后，两人终于接近了百兽峰，而不等靠近，远远就能听到此起彼伏的各种兽吼鸟鸣之声，鼻端更是传来了阵阵难闻的气味。
这让姜云不禁皱了皱眉头，对于问道宗内杂役弟子的处境，总算是有了个直观的印象，比起他们的待遇来，自己简直就是身在仙境一般。
陆笑瑜似乎生怕姜云会无法忍受这里的环境，急忙开口道：“姜师兄，这里是吵了点，气味也难闻了点，刚来时我也受不了，不过住习惯了就不觉得有什么了。”
姜云的心中叹了口气，他倒没有什么不能忍受的，在莽山之中，他甚至裹着凶兽的尸体睡过觉，只是颇为心疼陆笑瑜，这么小的女孩，却要长期生活在这样的地方，实在是有点可怜。
不过，这也让他意识到了，修道之路，真的是充满坎坷。
“没事！”姜云笑着道：“你负责的兽圈在哪里？”
问道五峰所擅长的道不同，身在其中的杂役弟子的任务自然也不同，像百兽峰的杂役，平日里的任务基本就是饲养各种凶兽，每个人都有一个专属的兽圈。
陆笑瑜伸手指着山脚之处一间间排列整齐的简陋房屋道：“那里是我们的住处，穿过去有一座山谷，兽圈就在里面。”
虽然兽圈是一个个单独的圈养之地，但百兽峰兽类众多，大多都是凶性十足，对于根本不懂御兽之道的杂役弟子来说，长期和它们相处还是极为危险的，所以为了以防万一，所有兽圈都集中在一起。
山谷的谷口内外更是设立了阵法，这样的话，即便兽群发生暴动，失控之下，至少也无法冲出山谷。
不过饶是如此，每年死在凶兽之口的杂役弟子也不在少数。
站在谷口之处，姜云朝内看去，也不禁轻轻的倒吸了口气。
呈现在他眼前的是一座占地至少数百里的巨大山谷，山谷之中，竟然有着各种各样的地形——平地，树林，沙漠，沼泽，甚至还有一个不小的湖泊。

而不管是地下，还是树上，亦或是水中，都有着一个个面积或大或小的黄色光圈，圈出了一定的范围，其内就着各种各样的凶兽。
一些光圈之中，还有着一个或者几个身穿灰色杂役服的弟子正在忙碌着。
简而言之，在姜云的眼中，这座山谷俨然就可以看做是一个小型的莽山，将各种凶兽按照各自的习性和生活的环境，分门别类的圈养了起来。
“姜师兄，那光圈就是兽圈，据说是一种法器，能够防止兽类逃出。”
content_en:
Jiang Yun, led by the little girl, walked towards the Hundred Beasts Peak.
Probably because someone was finally willing to help him, the little girl's mood improved. She jumped up and down along the way, pulling Jiang Yun to chatter. From the little girl's mouth, Jiang Yun naturally understood her situation.
This girl's name is Lu Xiaoyu. She has just turned twelve this year, two years older than Jiang Yuerou, and is now at the second level of Tongmai.
Speaking of which, Lu Xiaoyu's life experience was quite similar to Jiang Yuerou's. Both her parents were dead and she was dependent on her grandfather. However, when Jiang Yun asked her about her grandfather, Lu Xiaoyu was hesitant and refused to say more. She only said that her grandfather sent her to Taoism and left. Obviously, she had something unspeakable.
Jiang Yun naturally did not ask further questions, but the similar life experience made Jiang Yun care a little more about Lu Xiaoyu.
It's a pity that Jiang Yun himself is also a handyman in the Taoist Sect, so he can't give her any substantial help. He can only tell her where he lives so that if she encounters any difficulties again, she can go to him and he will try his best to help.
Hearing Jiang Yun's promise, Lu Xiaoyu's eyes turned into slits with joy, and she nodded in agreement.
More than an hour later, the two finally approached the Hundred Beasts Peak. Before they even got closer, they could hear the roars of various beasts and the chirping of birds in the distance, and waves of unpleasant smells could be heard from their noses.
This made Jiang Yun frown. He finally had an intuitive impression of the situation of the handyman disciples in the Taoist Sect. Compared with their treatment, he felt like he was in a fairyland.
Lu Xiaoyu seemed to be afraid that Jiang Yun would not be able to tolerate the environment here, so he hurriedly said: "Senior Brother Jiang, it's a bit noisy here, and the smell is a bit unpleasant. I couldn't stand it when I first came here, but once I got used to it, I didn't notice anything."
Jiang Yun sighed in his heart. There was nothing he couldn't bear. He even slept wrapped in the corpse of a ferocious beast in the Mang Mountains. He just felt sorry for Lu Xiaoyu. It was a bit pitiful for such a young girl to have to live in such a place for a long time.
However, this also made him realize that the road to spiritual cultivation is really full of ups and downs.
"It's okay!" Jiang Yun said with a smile: "Where is the animal enclosure you are responsible for?"
The Tao that the five peaks are good at is different, and the tasks of the handyman disciples in them are naturally different. For example, the daily tasks of the handymen at the Hundred Beasts Peak are basically to raise various ferocious beasts, and everyone has an exclusive animal enclosure.
Lu Xiaoyu pointed to the neatly arranged simple houses at the foot of the mountain and said, "That's where we live. There is a valley through which the animal pen is located."
Although the animal pens are individual enclosures, there are many beasts in the Hundred Beasts Peak, most of which are very ferocious. For handyman disciples who do not understand the way to control beasts, it is still extremely dangerous to live with them for a long time, so just in case, all the animal pens are gathered together.
Formations were set up inside and outside the valley's mouth. In this way, even if the beasts rioted and lost control, at least they would not be able to rush out of the valley.
However, despite this, there are not a few handyman disciples who die at the mouths of ferocious beasts every year.
Standing at the mouth of the valley, Jiang Yun looked inside and couldn't help but take a breath.
What appeared in front of him was a huge valley covering at least several hundred miles. In the valley, there were all kinds of terrains - flat land, woods, deserts, swamps, and even a large lake.
Regardless of whether it is underground, on a tree, or in the water, there are yellow circles of large or small area, which circle a certain range, and within them are various ferocious beasts.
In some circles of light, there are one or several disciples wearing gray uniforms who are busy.
In short, in Jiang Yun's eyes, this valley can be regarded as a small Mangshan, combining variousThe various ferocious beasts were kept in captivity in different categories according to their own habits and living environment.
"Senior Brother Jiang, that aperture is the beast circle. It is said to be a magical weapon that can prevent beasts from escaping."
